info.title: SciData Platform API
info.description: Production Research Platform for AI-Powered Scientific Image Data Management

/api/v1/auth/me.description: Retrieve authenticated user identity and role

/api/v1/projects.description: List all research projects or register a new project

/api/v1/projects/{id}.description: Retrieve project details and micrograph statistics

/api/v1/images.description: List micrographs with metadata, quality, and duplicate status

/api/v1/images/{id}.description: Get complete image profile with 6-indicator quality risk and duplicate cascade

/api/v1/images/{id}/similar.description: Retrieve top-K similar micrographs using exact FAISS index

/api/v1/search/hybrid.description: Hybrid visual + scientific metadata retrieval (Phase 5 fusion)

/api/v1/curation/review-queue.description: Get prioritized curation queue sorted by composite diagnostic risk

/api/v1/curation/reviews.description: Submit human curator decision or view completed reviews

/api/v1/models.description: List registered models with verified checkpoint SHA-256 hashes

/api/v1/provenance/image/{id}.description: Complete cryptographic event history and audit trail

/api/v1/system/health.description: System health check and FAISS index count

/api/v1/system/version.description: Pinned model versions and schema versions

/api/v1/dashboard/stats.description: Live database-derived dashboard statistics (no hardcoded metrics)
